GenAiPlugin.description: Handles all AI-driven QA test automation tasks. Executes UI test scripts against Salesforce orgs using browser automation. Can run test scripts, monitor progress, retrieve step-level pass/fail results, and list available scripts.
GenAiPlugin.scope: User wants to run, trigger, or execute a test script or suite. User asks about QA automation or UI test results. User wants to check run status or see what passed or failed.
